## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema`(`GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/layers` 的答案)新增可选成员 `draft`:待发布草稿行原样存储的样子,不翻译、不治理、不注入平台列;给了 `packageId` 时取该包的草稿,没有草稿时为 `null`。请求侧 `packageId` 的描述同步一句。只动 spec,不含服务端代码。
- 为什么改:中文(或任何非英文)界面下,Studio 和 Setup 用 `?state=draft` 读回的草稿是翻译过、带注入列的,再存回去就把译文和平台列写进了作者的草稿(#29814、#29793)。契约先行:先在 spec 声明这一层,#29814 再让 REST 路由和运行时分发器真正返回它。
- 风险与回滚:纯加宽,可选成员,旧服务端的答案照样能解析;不改任何已有成员。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` 的 `draft` 成员与上方 docblock 新段;其次 `meta-item-response-shapes.test.ts` 的三条新 pin。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/meta-item-response-shapes.test.ts`,预期 35 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`
  - `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema` gains `draft: z.unknown().optional()` beside `code`, `overlay` and `effective`. Its describe: the pending draft row exactly as stored (untranslated, ungoverned, no injected columns, unlike the `?state=draft` item read), for the requested `packageId` when one is given, `null` when no draft is pending; a client building an edit buffer reads `draft ?? overlay ?? code`; absent from a server that does not serve the layer, and absence means "not served", never "no draft".
  - The docblock above it says "layered" instead of "three-layer" and gains one paragraph on why the draft is a layer on `/layers` and not a query switch on the ordinary read. The #5882 rationale is untouched.
  - `GetMetaItemLayeredRequestSchema.packageId`'s describe adds that it also scopes the `draft` layer, so the request and response contracts say the same thing.
- Generated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (two rows) and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (one ledger row, `api/GetMetaItemLayeredResponse:draft`). No other artefact moved: `check:api-surface`, `check:export-origins` and `check:declaration-map` stayed green (no export added).
- `.changeset/29855-layers-draft-layer.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, with both declaration lines.

## Why

The ordinary `?state=draft` read serves the pending draft translated for the caller's locale and governed, with the platform's injected columns. Studio and Setup build their edit buffer from it and save it back, so the translations and the injected columns land in the author's draft. `/layers` is already the untranslated, author-owned read of the published layers, and the #5882 ruling (B) set one path, one response shape, so the draft joins the layers there instead of a switch that changes the ordinary read's representation.

This unblocks #29814 (the REST route and the runtime dispatcher serve the member), which unblocks #29793 (Studio and Setup move their edit buffers onto it).

## Tests

Three pins in the existing `GetMetaItemLayeredResponseSchema` describe of `packages/spec/src/api/meta-item-response-shapes.test.ts`, plus one compile-time pin at module scope:

- the schema accepts `draft` as an object and hands it through as stored, with the published layers unchanged;
- the schema accepts `draft: null` (no draft pending);
- an answer without `draft` still parses, and parses without the key;
- `LayeredDeclaresDraft`: `draft` is a key of `GetMetaItemLayeredResponse` (compiled by `tsconfig.test.json`, so `check:test-typecheck` reads it).

## Acceptance notes

- What a server does when `packageId` is absent is #29814's to settle and report; this contract only says the `packageId` scopes the draft when given.
- No server code here: until #29814 lands, every server answers without `draft`, which the third pin keeps parseable.
